intended_object: The standard topological group isomorphism Aut_cont(ℤ_p, +) ≅ ℤ_p^×, which sends a continuous automorphism φ to φ(1) and a unit u to multiplication by u. Here the automorphism group carries the congruence topology. This is taken from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation:
The definition is the rank-one case of the library's general result `Peripheral.continuousAutEquivUnits`, which identifies the continuous automorphism group of a free pro-p group of rank one with ℤ_p^×. It is applied to `Multiplicative ℤ_[p]` through the identification of ℤ_p with the free pro-p group on `Fin 1` (`freeProP.equivPadicInt`).

The lemmas that follow in the same file prove that the map sends φ to (φ 1).toAdd and that its inverse sends u to x ↦ u·x. That is exactly the classical isomorphism. It is bundled as a `≃ₜ*`, so it is a group isomorphism and a homeomorphism.

`ContinuousAut` is defined for monoids, so the additive group of ℤ_p has to be written as `Multiplicative ℤ_[p]`. This is only an encoding.

The object is a specific isomorphism attached to ℤ_p, and the more general rank-one statement already exists in the library. So being specific to ℤ_p does not make it too narrow. I found no Mathlib declaration giving this isomorphism.
